description: This file is a shell script that contains automated tests for Git and Perforce (P4) integration, specifically testing features of the 'git p4' tool. It includes setup and teardown routines, multiple test cases for cloning, importing, branching, and synchronizing code repositories between P4 and Git, as well as handling various configurations such as case sensitivity and client specifications.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server with default or specified configuration.

methods.name: stop_and_cleanup_p4d
methods.description: Stops the running Perforce server and performs cleanup.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git repository, removing temporary files and directories.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Configures the Perforce client view mappings.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output or files.
